newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open moderately lower following Dow slip.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open moderately lower following Dow slip.

text.p: UK shares started lower on Wednesday as marketmakers pushed prices down following Wall Street's modest fall on Tuesday but dealers said the FTSE's medium-term uptrend remained intact.
After a four-week advance, which saw the FTSE 100 climb around 440 points, or 10 percent, a few days of consolidation was inevitable, they said.

"We won't see much selling pressure today. Very few people want to sell stock at the moment," one senior dealer said. "But market makers will mark down prices until the buyers step in again." The FTSE 100 was down 3.3 points to 4,687.8 by 0738 GMT.
